slides.title: Paan ki pichkari ka bill kaun bharta hai?
Shaadi se laut rahe the.
slides.body:
Bunty ne meetha paan khaya.
Station ki seedhiyan, khaali corner.
Bunty: "Ek pichkari se kya hota hai?"

slides.title: Pichkari. Corner laal.
slides.body: Bunty aage badh gaya. "Chalta hai, sab karte hain."

slides.title: Agli subah...
slides.body: Safai karamchari ghanton ragadte hain. Daag phir bhi poora nahi jaata.

slides.title: Pinky: "Bill aayega. Tumhare naam pe."
slides.body: Brush, chemical, paani, majdoori. Sab public paisa. Yaani tumhara tax.

slides.title: Ek daag, do nuksaan.
slides.body: Deewar, pillar, seedhi kharab hote hain. Aur thook se infection failte hain. Isliye kai shehron mein public mein thookna fine wala offence hai.
slides.small: Fine ki rakam shehar ke municipal niyam pe depend karti hai.

slides.title: Indore ne kar dikhaya.
slides.body: Swachh Survekshan mein saal dar saal No.1. Wahan log khud ek doosre ko tokte hain. Safai aadat ban gayi.

slides.title: Pichkari rule:
slides.body:
Public mein thook nahi.
Dustbin ya washbasin tak ruko.
Deewar kisi ka canvas nahi.

slides.title: Ab Bunty khud tokta hai:
slides.body: "Bhai, deewar ne kya bigaada? Dustbin udhar hai."

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo har corner ko pichkari ka target samajhta hai.
